Tests that cost is tracked after a successful response

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using LiterLlm;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
using var client = LiterLlmConverter.CreateClientFromJson("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"budget\":{\"enforcement\":\"hard\",\"global_limit\":50.0},\"cost_tracking\":true}");
var result = await client.ChatAsync(new ChatCompletionRequest { Messages = new List<Message>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Message>("{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}", ConfigOptions)! }, Model = "gpt-4" });
Console.WriteLine(result);
```
